messages.risk.help.title: Risk
messages.risk.help.what: Track project risks, impact levels, mitigations, and review check-ins so critical blockers are never forgotten.
messages.risk.help.example-1: Log a release or dependency risk with triggers and a mitigation plan
messages.risk.help.example-2: Filter open high-impact risks and close them once mitigated
messages.risk.help.scope: Risk entries stay in this project’s local database; optional review reminders trigger locally under your permission.
messages.risk.help.advanced: Cross-reference goals so high-severity risks are double-checked before goal closure.
messages.risk.directory.name: Risk
messages.risk.permission.action.reason: Read or manage project risks with your access
messages.risk.permission.storage-private.reason: Save this project’s risks, linked items, and progress updates
messages.risk.permission.actions-delegate.reason: Verify linked items and schedule or archive risk reviews in Schedule with your access
messages.risk.read-group.risk.title: Risk
messages.risk.read-group.risk.description: Project risks, their linked items, and progress updates
messages.risk.actions.list.title: List risks
messages.risk.actions.list.description: Lists risks in this project, defaulting to open ones, with filtering by status, keyword, impact, owner, or linked item.
messages.risk.actions.get.title: Read risk
messages.risk.actions.get.description: Reads a risk’s details, linked items, and progress timeline with newest entries first.
messages.risk.actions.create.title: Record a risk
messages.risk.actions.create.description: Records a new open risk in this project with title, description, impact, and likelihood, plus optional mitigation, owner, and linked items.
messages.risk.actions.update.title: Update risk
messages.risk.actions.update.description: Updates specified fields on an open risk against the version you read. Refuses to overwrite newer edits, and closed risks must be reopened first.
messages.risk.actions.status-set.title: Change risk status
messages.risk.actions.status-set.description: Changes a risk’s status to open, mitigating, accepted, or closed with an optional note. Closing also archives its scheduled review.
messages.risk.actions.links-add.title: Link item to risk
messages.risk.actions.links-add.description: Links an item you can access to this risk after confirming it exists. Already linked items aren’t duplicated.
messages.risk.actions.links-remove.title: Unlink item from risk
messages.risk.actions.links-remove.description: Removes a linked item from a risk. Succeeds quietly if it wasn’t linked.
messages.risk.actions.notes-add.title: Add risk progress note
messages.risk.actions.notes-add.description: Adds a note to the risk’s progress timeline, keeping your exact wording.
messages.risk.actions.review-get.title: Read risk review
messages.risk.actions.review-get.description: Reads this risk’s review in Schedule, including its time, pause state, last run result, and read access.
messages.risk.actions.review-schedule.title: Schedule or reschedule risk review
messages.risk.actions.review-schedule.description: Schedules or reschedules a risk review in Schedule within one year, with an optional focus. Grant read access on the task permissions page so the review can read the risk.
messages.risk.actions.review-enabled.title: Pause or resume risk review
messages.risk.actions.review-enabled.description: Pauses or resumes a scheduled risk review. Past-due reviews need to be scheduled again.
messages.risk.actions.review-cancel.title: Cancel risk review
messages.risk.actions.review-cancel.description: Cancels this risk’s review by archiving the task in Schedule while keeping past results.
messages.risk.actions.presentation-values.title: Risk display fields
messages.risk.actions.presentation-values.descrip: Reads display fields for the requested risks within your current access, marking unavailable or deleted items without modifying data.
messages.risk.actions.presentation-overview.title: Risk home overview
messages.risk.actions.presentation-overview.descr: Reads a brief risk summary, top risks, and quick entry points. Read-only and doesn’t call a model.
messages.risk.actions.search-entries.title: List searchable risks
messages.risk.actions.search-entries.description: Lists project risks in batches for search indexing. Read-only and doesn’t modify data.
messages.risk.actions.subject-read.title: Read risk details and links
messages.risk.actions.subject-read.description: Reads a risk’s current text, version, and links for accurate reference.
